verdict.detail: The album first came out in 1967 (US).

notes.text:
Original US release date 1968.
"This Album Was Recorded In February of 1967"
"Also available on Musicassette No. 3113 073"

Cat. numbers for UK release:
On label: 2317 046
On rear: 2317 046 SELECT
On spine: VERVE SELECT 2317 046

Horizontal text on front:
Francis Vincent Zappa 
conducts
Lumpy Gravy
A curiously inconsistent piece which started out as a ballet but probably didn't make it.

Vertical text on front:
Abnuceals Emuukha Electric Symphony Orchestra & Chorus with maybe even some of the mothers of invention
In the text balloon on the back cover Frank Zappa says : "Is this phase 2 of: We're only in it for the money?"

Runouts are stamped.

Special thanks to: Sid Sharp, Bob Ross & Smiling Jack, Ben Barrett, Normal & Max, my pumpkin / Hurby & John Judnich
